name: E-Land Apparel Limited
about: E-Land Apparel Limited manufactures and sells garments and its related products in India and internationally. The company was formerly known as Mudra Lifestyle Limited and changed its name to E-Land Apparel Limited in January 2015. E-Land Apparel Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Bengaluru, India. E-Land Apparel Limited operates as a subsidiary of E-Land Asia Holdings Pte Ltd.
